answer: A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the vault graph and each exposes its bond to the nebula slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the island audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 32 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
